description: Population cargo jettison applies one alignment point per COL or SLV, regardless of starting alignment.

sql: UPDATE players SET alignment = 10 WHERE name = 'jettison_positive';
UPDATE players SET alignment = 0 WHERE name = 'jettison_zero';
UPDATE players SET alignment = -2000 WHERE name = 'jettison_negative';
DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name IN ('jettison_positive','jettison_zero','jettison_negative'));
UPDATE ships SET colonists = 2, slaves = 2, ore = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_positive');
UPDATE ships SET colonists = 1, slaves = 1, ore = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_zero');
UPDATE ships SET colonists = 2, slaves = 2, ore = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_negative');

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'COL', 2 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_positive' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'SLV', 2 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_positive' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'ORE', 1 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_positive' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'COL', 1 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_zero' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'SLV', 1 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_zero' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'ORE', 1 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_zero' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'COL', 2 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_negative' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'SLV', 2 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_negative' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'ORE', 1 FROM players WHERE name = 'jettison_negative' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;
